# AWS Icon Notes

This repository does not currently require AWS-specific diagrams, but the upstream draw.io references include a useful rule set for cloud diagrams.

Use these notes when a future diagram needs AWS service icons:

- prefer official service names and current icon sets
- use current `mxgraph.aws4.*` shapes when available
- avoid mixing official cloud icons with unrelated decorative icons
- keep icon sizes consistent across the same section
- add a legend if icon meaning is not obvious to the intended audience

If AWS icons are not central to the diagram, omit them rather than adding visual noise.
